text:
Maya (Design): hey team — kicking off the Tribridge launch hero kit. need 3 banner sizes (desktop/stacked/mobile) + one benchmark diagram for the webinar landing. who can take art + final exports?
Ethan (PM): I can own the layout and routing spec. deadline?
Maya (Design): preferably Thu EOD next week. want time for legal/brand sweep.
Priya (Content): copy almost locked. headline: 'Serve smarter — inference that scales.' short bullets I'll paste below.
Alex (Growth): ok can we also get 3 CTA variants for A/B test: 'Try Redwood' / 'See Benchmarks' / 'Register — Webinar' + tracking params. Need final image filenames to wire into GTM. @Maya
Priya (Content): quick bullets: • up to 40% lower unit cost vs baseline • consistent p95 latency under 150ms • unified hosted → private runtime. I'll make a short and a long version.
Ethan (PM): engineering gave rough perf: 'up to 40% lower unit cost' and p95 ~120ms on our small-rep tests. flagging legal for the exact wording.
Maya (Design): ok i won't hardcode numbers in hero text — will include a small stat callout box that can be swapped. I'll assemble in Figma and add export variants. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/tribridge/launch-hero
Alex (Growth): also need accessible alt text + 2:1 contrast checks for hero foreground. legal wants vector logos + usage manifest. please include layer names that match CTA filenames.
Maya (Design): will include alt text + export preset: SVG (logo), PNG@1x/@2x for banners, and a tiny CSV mapping image -> CTA -> utm string. example utm template: `?utm_source=launch&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=tribridge&utm_content={cta}`
Priya (Content): pasted final short headline variations: 1) 'Serve smarter — inference that scales.' 2) 'Predictable inference. Lower unit costs.' Long version in Drive link.
ArtBot (bot): Asset request logged as #ASSET-824. Workflow: design -> legal -> export -> growth handoff. ETA 48h for first pass.
Alex (Growth): thanks. once assets are in the CSV i'll prep GTM tags and share quick QA checklist. will schedule a 20m sync with Maya + Priya tomorrow morning.
Ethan (PM): syncing calendar invite now.
Maya (Design): cool — i'll push first draft to the file and call for brand sweep. :thumbsup:
Priya (Content): will ping legal after your first pass. :eyes:
Alex (Growth): perfect. tagging this as priority for launch week.
Maya (Design): noted — will include a fallback PNG for email, plus an SVG for docs.
Priya (Content): small ask — can we get a variant with the webinar date baked into the banner? if so i'll provide the date string by EOD.
Maya (Design): yep can do a dynamic text layer so we can swap the date.
Alex (Growth): all good. thanks everyone.
